name: compare-slider
title: Compare Slider
description: Two versions of a picture with a divider you drag to reveal either side; it nudges once to show it moves.

perf.budget: The divider and the clip move on the UI thread from one shared value; the pictures themselves never re-render. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: No nudge on mount, and taps and screen reader steps move the divider without a spring.
a11y.screenReader: One adjustable element named by accessibilityLabel; increment and decrement move the divider by a tenth and read how much of the first version shows.
a11y.touchTarget: The whole picture takes the drag and taps.
